paragraphs.text: Logan was the Keeper of Inys Haen , sixth in the line of his ancestor Haen the First, and father of Aylith .

By Year 520 of the Parting , Logan was a very old man, even for a Keeper - almost a hundred years old. He was hunched and arthritic, had pale gray eyes, and his hair was white, brittle, and thinning. Like all Keepers, he had the gift of Seeing, although it was much less powerful than Haen's Seeing had been, due to the severe damage done to the Clan Tree of Cridhe during the Parting .

Logan married only once and late in life, fathering Selka at nearly age 80. In year 520 of the Parting , the elderly Logan performed part of the spring ritual before being attacked by raiders from Inys Nohr . He managed to bestow his Keeper's Memories to his daughter Aylith and throw her clear of the fire, before being consumed by it himself.
